pages.ib_math.hero.description: Exclusive group of maximum 4 students, coordinated by Denisa Diaconescu, Associate Professor, Doctor in Mathematics. Our studio in the Erou Iancu Nicolae area offers the ideal space for performance, adapting to the requirements of large international schools.
pages.ib_math.hero.media.caption: Derived, explained so that they remain.
pages.ib_math.program.section_title: We cover the entire IB Mathematics curriculum.
pages.ib_math.program.section_descriptio: Regardless of the path a student chooses, we structure the preparation to exactly match the rigors of the real exam. We ensure that every concept mastered translates directly into points earned according to the official scales.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.name: Analysis & Approaches - SL | HL
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.profile: Recommended for students aiming for competitive faculties in fields such as Engineering, Physics, Pure Mathematics, Computer Science or Theoretical Economics.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.descriptio: We focus on algebraic rigor, complex functions, differential and integral calculus, trigonometry, and mathematical proofs.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.advice: We place particular emphasis on managing Paper 1 (the test in which the use of a computer is prohibited), where pure mathematical logic and calculation speed are vital for a grade of 7.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.name: Applications & Interpretation - SL | HL
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.profile: Recommended for students heading towards Business, Management, Social Sciences, Medicine, Psychology or Data Science.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.descriptio: The focus is on mathematical modeling based on real data, matrices, advanced inferential statistics, probabilities, and optimization.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.advice: This profile is highly technological. We teach students how to quickly run statistical simulations and algorithms on the graphical computing (GDC) to solve long investigation problems without wasting precious time.
pages.ib_math.program.helper_1: Not sure which profile or level (SL / HL) suits you?
pages.ib_math.program.helper_2: During the initial assessment at Mindventure, we not only test current knowledge, but also analyze the student's admission goals to recommend the optimal path that maximizes their chances of success.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_1.title: Clarity of concepts
pages.ib_math.hww.method_1.description: We directly and practically explain all the concepts from the official curriculum, providing students with the theoretical foundation necessary to address any type of problem.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_2.title: Logical decomposition of complex problems
pages.ib_math.hww.method_2.description: We teach young people how to approach difficult topics. We train them to break down complex statements into logical, clear, and easy-to-follow steps.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_3.title: Making the use of the graphics calculator more efficient
pages.ib_math.hww.method_3.description: We teach young people how to make the most of their graphing calculator (GDC) during the IB exam for exceptional results.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_4.title: Time management and exam strategies
pages.ib_math.hww.method_4.description: We develop personalized strategies for approaching questions, managing time effectively, and eliminating stress during the exam.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_5.title: Intensive training on real topics (Past Papers)
pages.ib_math.hww.method_5.description: We constantly monitor young people's progress on official exams from previous years and ensure that the approach to each exercise strictly adheres to the official criteria in the IB scales.
pages.ib_math.hww.section_description: At Mindventure, we don't encourage rote memorization or endless hours of chaotic work. We completely change the way students approach IB mathematics, transforming complex concepts into clear solution algorithms.
pages.ib_math.trainer.section_title_1: An international academic path dedicated to your child's success.
pages.ib_math.trainer.section_title_2: For top grades on a global exam like the IB, students don't need a generalist tutor, but a mentor who understands mathematics at a structural and applied level.
pages.ib_math.trainer.section_descriptio:
I am Denisa Diaconescu. I am an Associate Professor at the Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics (University of Bucharest) and a PhD in Mathematical Logic. Since 2008, I have been guiding entire generations of students and young people, instilling in them the rigor of analytical thinking.

My professional path combines academic excellence with the applicability of mathematics at the highest industrial level. I led advanced research projects in theoretical logic at the University of Bern (Switzerland). I worked for years as a researcher in distributed systems, where I carried out mathematical modeling for global technological protocols.

After a career dedicated to cutting-edge science, I chose to use this experience to help the new generation. That is why I founded Mindventure — a mathematics studio created to train young minds for success and independence, transforming uncertainty into logical clarity and excellent results
The IB exam is a major challenge. In addition to a solid grasp of mathematical concepts, it requires clear time and stress management strategies. In addition, elite tests such as Paper 3 or Internal Assessment (IA) research essays require real scientific investigative skills.
My experience of over 20 years in leading-edge research, mentoring and university teaching are the arguments that help me be an authentic guide for your child. At Mindventure, exam excellence comes with self-confidence.

pages.ib_math.faq.section_description: The most frequent questions about IB mathematics — from choosing the path to when it's worth starting.
pages.ib_math.faq.ask_card.title: Didn't find your answer?
pages.ib_math.faq.ask_card.description: Tell us your child's specific situation and we'll give you an exact answer, in a free 30-minute assessment.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_1.question: How are the groups structured and what happens if a student is in a different profile?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_1.answer: At Mindventure, groups are strictly homogeneous and have a limited number of maximum 4 students. We never mix different years of study (DP1 with DP2) nor different profiles. Young people from Analysis & Approaches (AA) work in completely separate groups from those from Applications & Interpretation (AI), respecting the specific curriculum of the chosen profile.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_2.question: How do you ensure that the curriculum taught coincides with that at my child's international school?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_2.answer: All our courses strictly follow the official guidelines issued by the International Baccalaureate Organization (IBO). Being aware of the specifics of each school in the area, we adapt the pace and the synthesis materials so that young people see an immediate correlation between their performance in the studio and the grades obtained in class.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_3.question: Why is the initial assessment mandatory and what does it consist of?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_3.answer: The IB exam is far too complex to start preparing "blindly." The initial 45-minute assessment is not a stressful grading test, but a diagnostic tool. We analyze the student's logical thinking, identify any gaps, and establish a personalized strategy aligned with the young person's academic goals.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_4.question: Are the training sessions held physically or online?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_4.answer:
At Mindventure, we strongly believe that math excellence is best built through direct interaction. By working "side by side" with young people, we can track their every step of reasoning in real time, instantly correcting small errors in logic or writing that make a difference in official scales. 

 That is why our courses are held exclusively physically, in the Mindventure studio in the Erou Iancu Nicolae area. Our location is strategically chosen to ensure maximum convenience for families in the community, being in close proximity to the major international schools in the North of the Capital: American International School of Bucharest (AISB), Cambridge School of Bucharest, Mark Twain and Olga Gudynn. Thus, students can reach us quickly, directly after the end of school courses.
